requirements.general_text: Any of These: A-Level / STPM: BBC including B in Mathematics and Chemistry. UEC: 15 points or less including A2 in Mathematics and Chemistry (5 subjects not less than B grade). WACE (Australian): ATAR 75 including 65% in Mathematics Method/Specialist and Chemistry. SACE (Australian): ATAR 75 including 15.0 in Mathematics Method/Specialist and Chemistry. Canada Year 12 High School Diploma: 75% including 70% in Mathematics and Chemistry. International Baccalaureate Diploma: 26 points including 5 in SL Chemistry and Mathematics AA (or 5 in HL Mathematics AI). Matriculation/Foundation: CGPA 3.0 including B in Mathematics and Chemistry. Diploma: A diploma in a related field – Engineering with a CGPA 3.0 including a B in Mathematics and Chemistry. Heriot-Watt University Malaysia Foundation in Science: Grade C average including C in Mathematics, Chemistry, and English. SMA 3 (Indonesia): 8.0 including 8.0 in Mathematics and Chemistry. Year 12 State Board High School Examination (India): 75% including 75% in Mathematics and Chemistry. Senior High School Graduation Certificate (China): 80% including 80% in Mathematics and Chemistry. Important Notes: Applications are strongly encouraged from individuals with a wide array of qualifications. Eligibility is best assessed through a completed application with academic documentation. Entry requirements in the prospectus and website may not always apply, and individual offers may vary. A Pre-Sessional English Program (PSEP) is offered for those not meeting IELTS 6.0. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent) with no score lower than 5.5. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 6.0 requirement.
